name: Volatility Risk Filter
rationale: Volatility filters test whether avoiding or reducing exposure during high-volatility regimes improves risk-adjusted returns.
expected_benefit: Lower drawdown and smoother returns during stressed equity markets.

canonical_variants.name: Realized-volatility cash filter
canonical_variants.description: Move to cash when realized volatility exceeds a prespecified threshold.
canonical_variants.hypothesis_template: A realized-volatility cash filter may reduce drawdowns by avoiding high-risk regimes.
canonical_variants.minimum_acceptable_performance: Reduce max drawdown by at least 25% relative while retaining at least 70% of benchmark CAGR.

canonical_variants.name: Volatility-target only
canonical_variants.description: Stay in the asset but scale exposure using a target-volatility risk control.
canonical_variants.hypothesis_template: A volatility-target-only overlay may improve drawdown-adjusted performance without binary cash exits.
canonical_variants.minimum_acceptable_performance: Reduce max drawdown by at least 20% relative while retaining at least 75% of benchmark CAGR.

canonical_variants.name: Low-volatility entry filter
canonical_variants.description: Allow entries only when realized volatility is below a threshold.
canonical_variants.hypothesis_template: A low-volatility entry filter may avoid unstable entry periods and improve Sharpe.
canonical_variants.minimum_acceptable_performance: Improve Sharpe versus buy-and-hold after realistic costs.

suggested_validation: Do not sweep many volatility thresholds initially.
Use stress periods and rebound periods as separate date windows.
Compare against both buy-and-hold and cash.
execution_notes: Only volatility-target overlays are currently executable. Volatility threshold indicators are not yet in the strategy schema.
